data.body: Investigation complete (INTERMEDIATE). Root cause confirmed: CI integration-scope falls through to full-diff when INTEGRATION_SCOPE empty because DSO-Story-Merge trailers on empty recovery commits yield 0 files, and pipeline doesn't distinguish 'all provenanced, no cross-branch' from 'no trailers found'. Fix: condition full-diff fallback on provenance-complete.marker + empty unprovenanced-shas.txt in ci.yml Union step.
